captions.detailed: A ceiling-mounted cassette air conditioning unit consisting of a square outer frame in light grey and a central dark grey square intake grille. Four rectangular air distribution flaps are positioned along each side of the frame, designed to rotate on their horizontal axes to direct airflow. Additionally, a small cylindrical mode selector dial is integrated into one corner of the frame, rotating continuously on its local vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a cassette air conditioning machine with a square ceiling panel frame, a central square intake grille, four independent perimeter flaps that rotate on horizontal axes, and a small cylindrical mode selector dial in one corner that rotates on its local vertical axis. Apply a clean light grey color to the frame and a dark grey finish to the central grille.
captions.factory: Construct the main body frame using a thin, wide Box with a central square pocket subtracted from it. Create the central intake grille as a smaller, thicker Box positioned inside the pocket. Model the four perimeter flaps as thin rectangular boxes, placing one on each side of the central grille, and define revolute joints for each flap. Add a small Cylinder in one corner of the frame to act as the mode selector dial, and define a continuous rotational joint for it.
